description: Lists the portal states the NetBox system defines (wraps NBAPI GetPortalStates). Returns STATEKEY/STATENAME pairs — the vocabulary get_portal_statuses reports against, and the values its STATEKEY filter accepts.

PORTALSTATES.description: Optional. "TRUE" returns portal states across all partitions; omitted, the controller returns states for the default or currently switched partition.

name: get_portal_states
